en: OK! I'll show you round the Pokémon Center!
Pokémon Centers heal your Pokémon for free! Bring them here whenever they're worn out.
Welcome! I'll take your Pokémon for a moment.
All done! Your Pokémon are full of energy again.
Next, the PC! That's the square machine by the wall. Any Trainer can use it for free.
You can leave Pokémon in it when your team is full, and take them out again whenever you like.
And the counters on the other side are the Poké Mart! You can buy and sell all kinds of items there.
The Poké Balls you catch Pokémon with are sold there too. Here, {player}, I'll give you some to start!
Next up, I'll show you how to use them! Meet me on Route 19, past the gate at the top of town!
The Pokémon Center is the same wherever you go. Isn't that handy?
